candidates.name: Cable Rope Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Pushdown
Novice
1
The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
2
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Skullcrusher
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Skullcrusher
Beginner
1
Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
3
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Cross Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Cross Pushdown
Advanced
1
Either use two handles or no attachment at all. Both sides of the cable crossover should be set to the top.
2
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a 45 degree angle with your torso.
3
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position

candidates.name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
Beginner
1
You can use any attachment. The cable should be all the way to the bottom of the machine. Face away from the machine.
2
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
3
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.

candidates.name: Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, cables should be above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

candidates.name: Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, with cables above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle downward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

candidates.name: Cable Alternating Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

candidates.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Skullcrusher
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bilateral Cross Skullcrusher
Beginner
1
Standing between crossed cables, holding opposite handles above your shoulders.
2
Extend your elbows fully, keeping your upper arms stationary.

candidates.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bilateral Cross Tricep Extension
Beginner
1
Stand between crossed high cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
2
Extend both arms downward while keeping your elbows beside your torso.
3
Squeeze your triceps, then slowly return to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
3
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press one handle forward and upward until your arm is extended.
3
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from the cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press one handle forward until your arm is fully extended.
3
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press both handles forward and downward until your arms are extended.
3
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

candidates.name: Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown
Novice
1
Stand facing cable holding bar with palms down, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
2
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown
Novice
1
Stand facing cable holding rope, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
2
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown
Novice
1
Stand facing cable holding handle with palm down, elbow bent, and shoulder flexed.
2
First extend your shoulder (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbow.

candidates.name: Cable Bar Skullcrusher
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bar Skullcrusher
Beginner
1
Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
3
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
Beginner
1
Face away from cable, hinge at hips, and grasp handle behind head.
2
Keep upper arm still and extend elbow until arm is straight.
3
Squeeze tricep at the top, then slowly return to starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Pushdown
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Pushdown
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
2
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbow until you feel your tricep contract.

candidates.name: Cable Leaning Single Arm Skullover
candidates.cardText:
Cable Leaning Single Arm Skullover
Intermediate
1
Stand in front of cable stack facing away to and lean torso slightly forward, holding handle overhead.
2
Break at the elbow until your forearm touch your bicep, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arm to the side of your head.
3
Bring your elbow back forward, then extend your elbows.
